root_cause.text: The `GET_INSTANCE_ID` macro in `drivers/platform/x86/hp/hp-bioscfg/bioscfg.h` allows out-of-bounds array access via an incorrect loop condition and triggers null pointer dereferences by failing to validate `attr_name_kobj` before accessing its members.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the loop condition from `i <= bioscfg_drv.type##_instances_count` to `i <` and adds a NULL check `if (bioscfg_drv.type##_data[i].attr_name_kobj &&` before dereferencing `attr_name_kobj->name` in the macro definition.
